title: Registry: expertise tags
description: registry/tags.json: the vocabulary of expertise tags (product plan 0.5 §4, §6). The Chancellor may only put these tags on a quest, so reputation per tag (character.skill_affinity) does not fragment into near-duplicates such as front-end / frontend. Copied from @elvaria/registry-default at init; the owner (or the Temple, through the owner) adds tags by editing this file.
$comment: Hand-written v1, the reviewed target; from P0-03 generated by `pnpm schemas` from zod (ADR 0003). Not expressible here: ids are unique. Display names live here for the CLI; the UI takes them through i18n.
